summary.prose: Building s1 starts at the bottom: a classified, timed gh runner and the move of the issue wrappers onto it, including the narrowed typed-create retry. On top of that go the port types with the approved issueOps field and a strict target resolver, then the GitHub adapter (identity, lookup, claim, issue operations) and loadTracker. Only then are the callers switched one group at a time (tracker-auto, the bugfix deps, the question comment), each held to its old gh sequence and failure result, and a final pass checks the whole suite and the list of operations left on the legacy path.

both default deps factories accept the optional labels and promptOnLostRef as today, including the 'no labels' result of the recovery when none are given

existing tracker.test.ts, tasks.test.ts (including the empty-login throw), setup.test.ts, tracker-auto.test.ts, tracker-tasks.test.ts and bugfix-tracker.test.ts keep passing unchanged, except the existing tests that pin the old catch-everything typed-create retry, which are updated to the new retry policy
